missionType: SEALED_EVALUATION — BLIND_TRANSFER + PATTERN_APPLICABILITY + CAUSAL_TRANSFER_OBSERVATION + BOUNDARY/OVERRIDE_EVALUATION + SCIENTIFIC_CLAIM_GATE
purpose: Observe whether Genesis correctly transfers learned organizational knowledge to unseen evidence, including cases where the correct action is to apply, confirm, ignore, or override that knowledge.

selectionMethod.description: All four Cohort 001 transfer-designated missions are executed. Selection is determined by the predeclared Cohort 001 design (GENESIS_ACADEMY_COHORT_001_v1.md, sealed at G5-03). No mission is added, removed, reordered, or substituted based on inspection of baseline organization, expected outcome, or pattern applicability. The execution order is the deterministic lexicographic mission-ID order: C001-02 → C001-04 → C001-06 → C001-08.

baselinePolicy.description: Genesis organization WITHOUT learned patterns. OrganizationPlanner({ patterns: [] }).

learnedPolicy.description: Genesis organization WITH trusted learned patterns available normally. OrganizationPlanner({ patterns: TRUSTED_PATTERNS }).
learnedPolicy.holdsConstant: same as BASELINE — only learned organizational knowledge differs

verificationPolicy.description: Independent verification checks mission truth (artifact existence + content correctness + mission-input preservation). Verification does NOT depend on which arm ran. FALSE_SUCCESSES = 0 is required.

transferClassificationRules.ACTIVE_TRANSFER: Pattern retrieved + applicable + applied + causally changes organization design (worker count or role composition) while correctness preserved.
transferClassificationRules.CONFIRMATORY_TRANSFER: Pattern legitimately applicable, but baseline organization already satisfies the learned preference. Pattern is considered but not applied. Correctness preserved.
transferClassificationRules.BOUNDED_TRANSFER: Pattern retrieved but current mission requirements provide a valid reason NOT to apply it. Pattern overridden/rejected/bounded. Mission remains correct.
transferClassificationRules.NON_APPLICABLE: No trusted pattern legitimately applies to the unseen mission. Genesis correctly does not retrieve or use one.
transferClassificationRules.HARMFUL_TRANSFER: Learned pattern changes organization AND that change causes lower correctness, failed obligation, failed verification, lower reliability, or another material regression.
transferClassificationRules.FALSE_TRANSFER: Pattern applied despite not being legitimately applicable. Semantic failure.

epistemicIsolation.workerInstanceIsolation: Each WorkerAgent construction is a separate logical instance with a scoped scripted reasoning provider (TASK-022A). No cross-instance hidden memory.
epistemicIsolation.missionIsolation: Fresh mission ID, fresh FlightRecorder, fresh workspace per arm. No mission-to-mission state leakage except explicitly declared trusted patterns.
epistemicIsolation.cohortIsolation: Transfer missions do NOT feed learning before their evaluation. No candidate generation, no promotion during G5-07.
epistemicIsolation.noEvaluatorLeakage: Verification reads only flight events + artifacts. The expected answer / gold organization is NOT in the worker prompt.
epistemicIsolation.noReasoningContinuityBetweenArms: Each arm uses its own fresh scripted reasoning provider queue. The Baseline Arm cannot observe Learned Arm output and vice versa.

frozenPatternState.rule: G5-07 is an evaluation stage. Trusted pattern state is frozen before execution. No new trusted patterns generated, no pattern promotion, no support-count modification, no pattern-applicability change between transfer missions. All selected missions see the same pre-G5-07 learned state.

scientificConstraints: DO NOT modify sealed mission wording, scope, capability hints, expected outputs, or acceptance checks.
DO NOT select missions based on inspection of baseline organization shape.
DO NOT promote transfer-derived candidates during G5-07.
DO NOT modify Evidence Signature v1.
DO NOT modify the quarantined pattern's status.
DO NOT pass-chase after observing results.
Production code change preferred: ZERO. Small correctness fixes only under Section 29.

allowed: If ACTIVE_TRANSFER under valid blind conditions: Genesis transferred previously learned organizational knowledge to an unseen mission and used it to causally influence organization design while preserving independently verified mission correctness (under scripted reasoning conditions).

If only CONFIRMATORY_TRANSFER: Genesis correctly retrieved and applied learned organizational knowledge to an unseen mission whose baseline organization already satisfied the learned preference; no additional organizational change was required.
If BOUNDED_TRANSFER: Genesis retrieved learned organizational knowledge on an unseen mission but correctly bounded or overrode it in response to stronger current-mission requirements.
